About Us

Welcome to
Gwithian Farm.

Clair, Mike and family welcome you to their family-run campsite in the beautiful village of Gwithian, West Cornwall. Set in superbly landscaped gardens behind a 16th century thatched farmhouse, we're perfectly positioned for a genuine Cornish camping holiday.

A dog-friendly beach is just ten minutes' walk through the dunes, and we're a short drive from St Ives with easy access to the A30. We pride ourselves on a quiet, relaxing site with friendly, helpful owners always on hand.

✓Tents, caravans, motorhomes & campervans
✓Free luxury hot showers
✓Free WiFi across the whole site
✓40 hard standing pitches
✓Laundry, ironing facilities on site
✓Children's sandpit & picnic area
✓Pets welcome on leads
✓Pub opposite — real ales & good food
✓Wetsuit & bodyboard hire
✓Miles of coastal path walks
✓Table tennis & goats on site
✓Free ice pack freezers & phone charging
🏆 As featured in: The Sunday Times Top 40 UK Campsites · The Telegraph Europe's Top Campsites · The Guardian 10 Best Family Campsites · St Ives Times & Echo Best in the UK

Accommodation

Choose your
perfect pitch.

All pitches are a generous 10m × 10m. We don't do overcrowding — this is Cornwall, not a car park.

⚡

Electric Pitch

Full 16-amp hook-up for motorhomes, campervans and tourers. Numbered, clearly marked, plenty of room.

£30/ night
2 people included 16amp electric supply All facilities access
🏕️

Non-Electric Pitch

Back to basics — but with full access to everything on site. Perfect for tents, pop-ups, and campervans who love it simple.

£24/ night
2 people included Tent, van or caravan All facilities access

On-Site

Everything you
need.

🚿

Luxury Showers

Hot, powerful, properly clean. Because roughing it doesn't have to mean cold showers.

🛒

On-Site Shop

Essentials, local produce, Cornish snacks, and our own clothing range. Open daily in season.

📶

Free WiFi

Strong signal across the site. Stay connected — or let the kids stream something at bedtime.

🐕

Dog Friendly

Well-behaved dogs very welcome. The beach is dog-friendly year-round and the dunes are a joy.

🔥

Fire Pits

Nothing beats a campfire. Fire pits available and logs on site — evening sorted.

🅿️

On-Pitch Parking

Each pitch has dedicated parking. No lugging bags across a field.

Food & Drink

No need to
go far.

A rotating selection of food trucks pulls up on site every evening. Go straight from beach to supper without touching a pan.

🐟

Fish & Chips

Proper Cornish batter. Fresh catch. What else did you expect?

🍕

Wood-Fired Pizza

Stone-baked sourdough. Genuinely very good.

🍛

Curry Van

Rich, warming, fragrant. Perfect for Atlantic evenings.

☕

Barista Coffee

Specialty coffee every morning. Not instant. Never instant.
